title: Application and Fees
before:
All Applications can be completed online through our Maine Educator Information System (MEIS).  Please see the instructions below. 

How to Prepare to Apply
  • Review your official transcript to see if there is a note regarding the approved program you completed. If you do not see anything on the transcript regarding this, please be prepared to submit a verification of the approved program form. This form can be here. 
  • If applying for an endorsement, please be familiar with each endorsement code.  Those can be found under "Certification Requirements" on the left hand side of the page.  
  • If you have sent in transcripts previously, they do not need to be sent in again unless you have updated or new transcripts.  
  • All other documentation such as test scores, contact hours, etc. can also be uploaded as PDF documents during the application process. 
  • If you have transcripts from colleges outside the United States, you must submit a foreign transcript course by course evaluation completed by a company who is a current member of NACES as shown on their website (Members – NACES).
  • Note for Career and Technical Education teachers & school nurses: You must send a resume of paid work experience related to your endorsement area. The resume must include dates, number of years/weeks in the position and descriptions of work experience.

notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.
434 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "Non-Refundable Fees" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 2 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: All Applications can be completed online through our Maine Educator Information System (MEIS). Please see the instructions below.

decisions.label: Bring every heading up to h3 or above
decisions.why: 1 heading sat at h4 or deeper inside a card, a callout, a contact block or an accordion panel — components the outline walk leaves alone because they label a thing rather than a section. A reader using a screen reader still hears the level, so a fourth-level title inside a page that only goes to three is announced as belonging to a level that does not exist. Each is styled by its class and its position rather than its number, so nothing changes on screen.
